item.title: FBI, St. Paul police probing ICE arrest that resulted in skull fractures
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — Minnesota and federal authorities are investigating the alleged beating of a Mexican citizen by immigration officers last month, seeking to identify what caused the eight skull fractures that landed the man in the intensive care unit of a Minneapolis hospital. item.description: CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla.
